crossRefs.note: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous…
Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

translations.web: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
translations.bsb: Stay away from a foolish man; you will gain no knowledge from his speech.
translations.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
translations.asv: Go into the presence of a foolish man, And thou shalt not perceive in him the lips of knowledge.
